name: Waldbaden im Pitztal
beschreibung:
=== description ===
**Shinrin-Yoku – the Japanese art of forest bathing** in the dense pine forest of the **Pitztal**. A certified health educator guides you through mindful exercises and meditations in the woods. Mindful breathing, walking barefoot on moss, and listening to the sounds of nature offer deep relaxation for both body and mind.
